page.layout: Two parallel columns of grammatical entries on one printed page, left column then right column. Page number and running head at the top, left and right. No headings, notes, or footer.

main_text.l: m. fut. Kal, R. אָכַל.
וַיַּאכְלוּם & cibarunt eos, 3. pl. m. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. אָכַל.
וַיֹּאֶל & acquievit, & adjuratione obstrinxit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יָאַל; vel à Rad. אָלָה.
יֵאָמֵן confirmetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָמַן.
וַיַּאֲמֵן & credidit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. אָמַן.
יֵאָמֵן robustus erit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. אָמַן.
יֵאַמְּנוּ, & יֵאַמֵּן fortificabit, 3. f. m. fut. Piel, & Hiph. Rad. אָמַן.
שֶׁיֵּאמְדוּ quam dicebant, 3. pl. masc. fut. Kal, Rad. אָמַר.
יֵאמַר, vel י. ר dicetur, &c. fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. אָמַר.
יֵאָנֶה tradetur, fut. Pual, 3. f. m. R. אָנָה.
יֵאָנַח suspirat, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָנַח.
יֵאָנַף irascetur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. אָנַף.
יֵאָנַק exclamabit, 3. f. m. fut. Kal, R. אָנַק.
יֵאָנֵשׁ aegritudine afficietur, pro יֵאָנֵשׁ fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. אָנַשׁ.
יֵאַסֵּף addet, pro יֹסִיף, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. יָסַף.
יֵאָסְפוּן congregabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. אָסַף.
וַיֵּאַסְפֵם & congregavit eos, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. אָסַף.
יֵאָסֵר vincietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָסַר.
יֶאְסֹר ligabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. אָסַר.
יֵאַסְרוּנִי vinciant me, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. אָסַר.
יֵאַפּוּ coquent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. אָפָה.
וַיֵּאָצֵל & sepofuit, Num. 11.25. pro יֵאָצֵל, fut. Hiph.

page.notes: Vowel points are simplified and some Hebrew forms in the first and last lines are uncertain; the scan is small. Printed Latin spellings ("sepofuit", "mafc.", "Hiph.") are kept as printed. The running head shows the Hebrew letter א in each column. Marks such as "י.ר" and "R." are printed abbreviations and are kept as they stand.
